message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Build, test and publish nnef_tools

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'nnef_tools-v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'


jobs:
  build_nnef_tools:
    name: Build and publish nnef_tools
    runs-on: "ubuntu-latest"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('nnef-pyproject/pyproject.toml', 'nnef_tools-pyproject/pyproject.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install build pytest pytest-xdist

      - name: Build package
        run: python -m build ./nnef_tools-pyproject/ --outdir ./dist/

      - name: Publish artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dist-${{ github.ref_name }}
          path: ./dist/*

      - name: Install
        run: python -m pip install ./nnef-pyproject/ ./nnef_tools-pyproject[full]

      - name: Test
        run: python -m pytest ./nnef_tools-pyproject/tests/ -n auto

      - name: Publish to PyPI
        uses: pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@v1.13.0
        with:
          user: __token__
          password: ${{ secrets.PYPI_TOKEN }}
",
  "rationale": "Add a pip dependency cache before installation. The workflow repeatedly downloads dependencies (pip, build, pytest, pytest-xdist and the project packages) on every run but has no cache, so dependency fetching is repeated. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (Cache dependency downloads) reports a measured modest benefit and requires repeated dependency fetching with cache inputs keyed to the dependency manifest; both pyproject.toml files are used as the cache key. The change keeps installation and all required build/test steps intact, adds no secrets, privileged actions, publishing changes, or new network access, and does not weaken permissions.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
